parsed.post: Discarding last experiment (val_bpb 1.123). It seems increasing capacity without adjusting LR led to divergence or overfitting within the 5-minute window. Reverting to baseline 1.103889. Next: I'll try decreasing MATRIX_LR to 0.05 to see if more stable, slower convergence helps.
parsed.description: Reducing learning rate from 0.08 to 0.05 to improve stability and convergence quality.
